repairs.F1-mutable-static-array-len: Call access(base) before generating array length constant; mutable static and nested fields retain unsafe access requirement.
repairs.F1-array-count-capacity-category: Separate integer type validation from u32 representation limit for type array counts and repeat counts; oversized integers report I_LIMIT with source position.
repairs.F1-unbounded-place-recursion: Make is_place iterative; bound place depth at 64; additionally bound statement nesting and constant/static AST walks at 64, including else-if and left-associative constant chains.
repairs.F1-capacity-diagnostic-overflow: Report rejected array counts without multiplication. All struct/Result size additions and alignment padding use overflow-checked size_add and report I_LIMIT before overflowing.

diagnostic_units.array_count_representation: actual and limit are element counts, limit 4294967295.
diagnostic_units.array_size_capacity: actual is requested element count, limit is floor(67108864 / element_size); no rejected product is evaluated.
diagnostic_units.aggregate_size_addition_or_alignment: actual is requested additional bytes; limit is remaining representable usize bytes (usize::MAX - current_size). No new structure-size hard cap.
diagnostic_units.recursive_walks: actual and limit count active calls in the named recursive walk; AST walkers share the constant/static walk counter.
